attchmntText: Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Limited submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.9.2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 11.11.2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 26,369.37 lakhs. Profit for the period was Rs. 714.10 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 0.89. For the half year, revenue was Rs. 48,020.30 lakhs. Profit was Rs. 2,095.70 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 1.73. Total assets stood at Rs. 1,02,435.19 lakhs. Total equity was Rs. 50,261.83 lakhs. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified limited review report. The company noted the forfeiture of Tranche I convertible equity warrants.

attchmntText: Bannari Amman Spinning Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
